youtube.baslik: How does a directional microphone suppress sound from behind? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: A directional system uses two microphones about one centimeter apart; the processor briefly delays the rear microphone signal and subtracts it from the front one, so sound from behind cancels. The benefit is greatest when the listener faces a nearby talker and the noise is behind.
